_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy to fleet.json and replace with the real fleet.
Two axes, deliberately separate: a SHAPE is what an agent is (persona, model,
tools) and an AGENT is its runtime configuration (ID, channels, jobs, duty cycle).
Ten agents may share one shape, or have ten. Both are expressible here.

generalist.description: General-purpose persistent agent for files, research and local tasks.

research.description: Longer-running literature and market scans; writes local reports.

jobs.prompt: Summarise anything I should know before the day starts.
